$comment: module -> { flows it owns, source paths in the app repo that can affect it }.
source_paths are glob patterns matched against `git diff --name-only` of the app repo
(repoPath / APP_REPO_PATH). No matching diff since the last successful run => the module is
skipped at zero cost. Changes under _global invalidate every module. Err broad: a glob that
is too narrow means a missed change, which is the failure mode that matters.
